description: M5 item 8 — INSTALLED profile manifest. An installed image carries ONLY the persistent root (+ first boot); the Live-only installer/recovery payloads are dropped. tools/install_disk.py builds the installed ESP's limine.conf by keeping only the boot modules listed in manifests/installed-modules.txt (initrd.img), so installer-esp.img and installer-bios.bin are NOT present on the installed disk. Booting the installed disk (--build-disk, which runs install_disk.py) must therefore show the initrd payload present but BOTH installer payloads unavailable, and still mount the persistent root at /persist — proving the installed profile = persistent root + first boot, with the installer absent. This is the data-driven counterpart to tools/m8_live_profile_markers.json. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build-disk --markers-file tools/m8_installed_profile_markers.json --timeout 200 --boot-timeout 150 --post-boot-delay 2.5 --settle 3

required.claim: the installed image carries the persistent-root initrd module
the Live-only installer ESP payload is NOT on the installed image — the manifest split is real
the Live-only installer BIOS payload is NOT on the installed image
the installed persistent root was mounted at /persist
the installed disk booted to the terminal

forbidden.why: the installer payload leaked onto the installed image — the manifest split failed
the installer BIOS payload leaked onto the installed image
